name: ultimate-frontend-skills
description: Cinematic, editorial frontend design for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: ultimate-frontend-skills
plugins.description: Ultimate Frontend Skills (UFS for Claude). Build cinematic, editorial websites the way an award-winning studio does, on one route from brief to ship: a corpus of award-winning reference sites to decide against, WebGL mesh gradients, three-plane parallax with real depth, procedural and Blender-modelled three.js exploded product views, CC0 PBR materials and HDRI lighting, scroll choreography in GSAP and anime.js, and a typographic system that does not read as AI-generated. Ships a copy-in CSS chassis, motion and WebGL runtimes, a section library, a scaffolder, a headless render check, a bench detector that defers to frontend-design when it is installed, and one verify verdict.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Puts your remaining Claude Code usage limit into Claude's context before every prompt, so it opens with what fits in the budget instead of starting work that gets cut off. Reports headroom as turns rather than percentages, prices a job before you start it, and detects your plan tier.

plugins.name: image-deep-research
plugins.description: Image deep research for Claude Code and Codex: find reference images on open, licensed collections (Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, Art Institute of Chicago, the Met) with every URL verified and every licence kept, render real websites into screenshot contact sheets, measure a live site's palette and typefaces, and build moodboards - visual research for design references, styles, palettes, typefaces, materials and competitors.
